text:
Jason Robertson's name has been in trade talk since the summer, and it hasn't gone away: a report this week said the Penguins were "very close" to a deal at one point (NHL Trade Rumors). Meanwhile he is doing his job in Dallas. He has 10 goals and 26 points in 22 games, an overtime winner against Florida on Nov. 15 and a hat trick in Washington on Nov. 3.

He remains a volume shooter in the best sense. He has 72 shots in 22 games, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 90th percentile for chances from in front of the net last season. Evolving-Hockey rated him the 14th most valuable forward in 2025-26.

The flag is on-ice luck: Dallas has scored 9.1 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, and its 5v5 expected goal share with him out there is a modest 52.8%. His own shooting (13.9%) is right on normal, so the goals look real. Our season range is 80 to 105 points, and the trade question hangs over every one of them.
